info.title: MICROSERVICE-testDev-Create Catalog Azurite Pendant Detail-v1-spec
info.description: The Azurite Pendant Detail Management API enables businesses to streamline the creation and management of detailed information about azurite pendant products. By utilizing this API, consumers such as e-commerce platforms and inventory management systems can automate the addition of new pendant details to their catalogs. Key operations include specifying product attributes, images, and pricing to enhance the user experience. This API is designed for developers looking to integrate robust product detail capabilities into their applications.

post.summary: Create a new azurite pendant detail.
post.description: This endpoint allows users to create a new detail for an azurite pendant. Provide the necessary details in the request body to successfully create the pendant detail.
